rows.evidence: Q1: Sections 2.2-2.3 <U+2014> own field sampling (50 and 33 points, 0-10 cm, EC1:5 in lab) on 8 May and 12 June 2022 and own UAV Nano-Hyperspec flights over a 5.34 ha cotton field. Q2: Section 3.6 and Table 4 <U+2014> PSO-GPR model built on 0.7-order FOD bands selected by BOSS plus 2D/3D indices reached test-set R2 0.9201, RMSE 0.1535 dS m-1, RPD 3.54; Section 3.7/Fig. 11 <U+2014> salinity maps for emergence and squaring periods generated from this model. Q7: Section 4.1 and Fig. 13 <U+2014> from their own signal-to-noise results the authors state that a differential order below 1.0 should be selected to obtain more accurate predictions, and Section 2.7 states that minimizing image noise and cover-induced distortion is essential for accurate prediction. Q8: Section 4.4 <U+2014> limited study area restricted inclusion of environmental factors such as parent material and regional salinity composition; only 400-1000 nm UAV data used, lacking NIR/SWIR; no integration with ground spectra or satellite data; some feature-selection strategies may fail to remove noise, and multicollinearity may affect inversion accuracy.
rows.notes: The study supports the monitoring part of the passage (UAV hyperspectral + PSO-GPR predicting topsoil salinity with R2 0.92, RMSE 0.15 dS m-1). The further assertion that this reinforces irrigation management and salinization mitigation is only discussed/recommended (Section 3.7 lists amendments, intercropping, deep tillage as possible measures), not tested. Q3 no: a single method (spectral model validated against lab EC) <U+2014> ground truth validation is not a second independent method. Q4 no: the chlorophyll/water-uptake mechanism linking salinity to canopy spectra is asserted, not measured; band-EC correlations are the method itself. Q5/Q6 no: one 5.34 ha field in Wujiaqu, two growth periods. Q9 no: only RMSE/R2/RPD reported; the 20 training repetitions are summarised by the best model only and no dispersion for the prediction result is given (SD reported only as descriptive statistics of samples). Q7 answered yes with some doubt since the stated condition (differential order below 1.0; noise minimisation) is methodological rather than biophysical/social.

notes: Full text appears complete (abstract through references). Single-field UAV hyperspectral salinity inversion study in Xinjiang mulched drip-irrigated cotton; figures are referenced but not visible in the text.
